golf_options.title: Golf the code
golf_options.intro: Golfing always strips comments, collapses whitespace, and shortens numeric literals. Values (and therefore the auto-detected sliders) stay unchanged regardless of the settings below.
golf_options.algebra_tooltip: Can occasionally produce invalid code on expressions involving a member access/swizzle (e.g. p.z*0.) — in that case the golf is automatically rolled back (see the "Golf cancelled" dialog). Uncheck this if that happens to you often.

golf_common_confirm.title: Golf the code
golf_common_confirm.body:
Golfing strips comments and collapses whitespace and numeric literals. Common is never renamed or pruned (its declarations are used by other passes golfed separately).

Continue?
